Accesstage S/A.note: The company was acquired from Mitsubishi's venture capital fund in 2007 by its executives Celso Sato, Fernando Takano, and an angel investor.

Aurionpro Solutions Limited.note: Aurionpro Solutions Limited acquired Fintra Software Private Limited in 2025 but remains independent itself.

Lendscape Limited.note: Lendscape was acquired by private equity firm Bowmark Capital in July 2023.

MVGX Tech Pte. Ltd..note: MVGX Tech operates as an independent sustainability technology provider and has not been acquired.

Nobo Finance Limited.note: Bharti Global acquired NOBO Finance in May 2026.

Polytrade Finance.note: Polytrade Finance operates independently as a blockchain-based trade finance and real-world asset tokenization platform.

RootAnt Global Pte Ltd.note: RootAnt Global remains an independent embedded finance and banking-as-a-service startup.

TASConnect Pte. Ltd..note: TASConnect operates as an independent SaaS supply chain finance platform incubated by SC Ventures.

TradeFinex Tech Ltd..note: TradeFinex Tech Ltd. operates independently as the trade finance protocol promoter for the XDC Network.

UAE Trade Connect LLC.note: UAE Trade Connect was rebranded as haifin by its parent consortium led by e& enterprise in 2024.

WEFIN LICENCIADORA S.A..note: WEFIN LICENCIADORA S.A. remains an independent company with an active corporate registration in Brazil.

AfriTrade Networks.note: AfriTrade Networks is an independent company launched in early 2026 to offer trade compliance solutions under the AfriTrade AI brand.

Demica Finance Limited.note: Fidelity National Information Services (FIS) completed the acquisition of Demica in February 2025 for approximately $300 million.

Kanastra Ltda..note: Kanastra Ltda. remains independent and raised a $30 million Series B funding round in October 2025.

PrimaDollar Operations Ltd.note: PrimaDollar remains independent after divesting its SME export trade finance business portfolio to Modifi in February 2021.

Vayana Network.note: Vayana Network is an independent trade financing network that has raised multiple venture funding rounds.
